Theorem
[Shi's estimates with initial derivative bounds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0271, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0272, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0273 ↗ lem:chow-ii-modified-shi-derivative-quantity 1. ch14:14.16\group Local Curvature Estimates

Let $\ell \ge 0$, $n\ge 2$, $m\ge 1$, and let $\alpha ,K,K_\ell ,r>0$. Suppose $0< au \le \alpha /K$, $\overline B_{g(0)}(p,r)\Subset \mathcal U$, and \[ |\operatorname {Rm}(x,t)|\le K, \qquad | abla ^ eta \operatorname {Rm}(x,0)|\le K_\ell \quad (0\le eta \le \ell ) \] on the indicated ball and time interval. Then \[ | abla ^m\operatorname {Rm}(y,t)|\le rac{C(\alpha ,K,K_\ell ,r,\ell ,m,n)}{t^{(m-\ell )_+/2}} \] on $B_{g(0)}(p,r/2) imes (0, au ]$. In particular, derivatives of order at most $\ell $ are uniformly bounded through time zero.
Proof

\sketch Induct on $m$, using the initial bounds when the maximum of the localized quantity occurs at time zero. Lemma 4 and a cutoff from Lemma 2 show at a positive maximum of $\eta F_{m,\ell }$ that either

\[ 0\le -c(\eta F_{m,\ell })^2+C\eta ^2+C\eta F_{m,\ell } \]

or the same inequality after multiplication by $t$. Hence $\eta F_{m,\ell }\le C$, which gives

\[ | abla ^{m+1}\operatorname {Rm}|^2\le Ct^{-(m-\ell +1)_+} \]

on the next inner ball. Nested radii approaching $r/2$ complete the induction and give the stated estimate.

□
